recent_posts.title:
Wiz security scanning is now natively integrated into Lovable, extending your Wiz policies to every Lovable project.

Here's what that means in practice: When someone on your team builds an app in Lovable, Wiz scans run alongside Lovable's built-in security checks. Findings surface right in the security view with severity, remediation steps, and a direct link into Wiz for deeper investigation. Everything flows back into your Wiz Code and Build scans page, so your security team has full visibility.

For developers: fix issues without leaving Lovable.

For security teams: Lovable projects show up alongside everything else you monitor in Wiz.

For leadership: no blind spots, no shadow IT - governance follows your teams wherever they build.

If you're already on Wiz, connecting takes just a few minutes.
recent_posts.summary: Wiz security scanning is now natively integrated into Lovable, allowing security policies to extend to every Lovable project. When developers build apps in Lovable, Wiz scans run alongside built-in security checks, surfacing findings with severity ratings, remediation steps, and links for deeper investigation. Results flow into Wiz's Code and Build scans page, giving security teams full visibility. Developers can fix issues without leaving Lovable, while security teams see Lovable projects alongside all other monitored assets, eliminating shadow IT blind spots.
